title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 5. Recalls the importance of the EU achieving greater strategic operational capability and defence readiness, as outlined in the Strategic Compass, to ensure that its objectives are aligned with the collective and sovereign interests of its Member States and the broader vision of European security and defence; acknowledges, in this regard, that some Member States have long-standing policies of military neutrality, and respects the right of every Member State to determine its own security policy;
